station_name: Cristianitos Creek near San Clemente, Calif.
township_range_section: SW¼NW¼ sec.25, T.8 S., R.7 W.
notes: Daily discharge table titled water year October 1965 to September 1966. Daily values are printed for November to June only; the October, July, August and September columns are empty with monthly totals of 0, so the water year is given to the month. gage_height is listed because the foot line of the table ('Peak discharge (base, 100 cfs)') prints two peaks with gage heights (7.50 ft, 6.20 ft). Location text also gives: on right bank 900 ft downstream from Talenga Canyon, 2.3 miles upstream from mouth, and 2.8 miles northeast of San Clemente. No county on the page.
